document.id: Pueblo de San Ildefonso Council Res. No. SI-R26-012
document.heading: PUEBLO DE SAN ILDEFONSO COUNCIL RESOLUTION NO. SI-R26-012
Leasing and Mortgage Act Amendments of 2026
document.preamble: At a duly called meeting of the Council of San Ildefonso Pueblo on the 25th day of June, 2026, the following resolution was adopted:

recital.text: the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Pueblo") is a sovereign and self-governing Tribe, recognized as such by the United States of America; and,
the Council of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso is vested with the authority to make and pass laws by the governing Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso; and,

the Council has become aware of the need to clarify certain authorities that the Council had delegated to the San Ildefonso Housing Authority ("SIHA") in the Pueblo's Leasing and Mortgage Act of 2024 relating to the authority of SIHA to approve tribal leasehold mortgages; and,

the Council now deems it necessary and proper to amend those provisions of the Pueblo's Leasing and Mortgage Act to clarify and reaffirm SIHA's delegated authority to approve tribal leasehold mortgages.
that the Council hereby enacts the attached law entitled the "LEASING AND MORTGAGE ACT AMENDMENTS OF 2026".

procedural-data.text: The foregoing resolution was duly voted upon by the Council on June 25, 2026, at a meeting with a vote of 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 2 abstaining and 2 absent (Governor presiding and not voting) pursuant to the authority vested in the Council by the Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso.

text.strong: DELIVERY OF THE RESOLUTION TO THE GOVERNOR:

procedural-data.text: Resolution No. SI-R26-012 was presented to the Governor of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso on the 26th day of June, 2026, pursuant to the governing Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Agreement"), GOVERNOR, Sec. 4(c), and will become effective after signature by the Governor or veto override by the Council.

attachment.heading: THE LEASING AND MORTGAGE ACT AMENDMENTS OF 2026

section.heading: Short Title
section.text: This enactment shall be known as the "Leasing and Mortgage Act Amendments of 2026" ("Act")

section.heading: Purpose
section.text: The purpose of this Act is to amend certain provisions of the Pueblo's Leasing and Mortgage Act to reaffirm and clarify the authority delegated by the Council to the San Ildefonso Housing Authority ("SIHA") to establish a leasing process and to approve residential leases and leasehold mortgages.

section.heading: Findings
section.text: The Council hereby finds and declares that:

para.text: the Council has become aware of the need to clarify certain authorities that the Council had delegated to the San Ildefonso Housing Authority ("SIHA") in the Pueblo's Leasing and Mortgage Act of 2024 relating to the authority of SIHA to approve tribal leasehold mortgages.

the Council now deems it necessary and proper to amend those provisions of the Pueblo's Leasing and Mortgage Act to clarify and reaffirm SIHA's delegated authority to approve tribal leasehold mortgages.
Section 15.3.1.070 Mortgage of Leasehold Interests Prohibited Without Lease is hereby amended to read:

section.heading: Mortgage of Leasehold Interests Prohibited Without Lease

para.text: Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary contained in this Act or in any Mortgage document, no Borrower may mortgage a Leasehold Interest without first:
Obtaining a Lease for such property on a form prescribed by the Authority and approved by the Authority in accordance with the Authority's established leasing process; and
Obtaining the prior written approval of the Authority to mortgage the Leasehold Interest.

The Authority's residential lease form may allow a Lessee to mortgage the leasehold for the purchase, construction, rehabilitation, or refinancing for residential purposes without further Authority consent.
Any Mortgage given in violation of this Section shall be void and of no effect.
This Act and any amendments thereto shall take effect on the date enacted by the Council.
